page.overview:
Who is Human Spider?

The Human Spider was a pet of Baron Vladimir Harkonnen.

The creature was kept on Giedi Prime by Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. It was eating food when Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam arrived to meet with the Baron. She told Piter de Vries that the creature must leave. Piter told her that she could speak without fear, for the creature did not understand their language. She ordered it to get out using the Voice, which compelled it to leave the room.
